name: Accel Limited
about: Accel Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the information technology service, animation, engineering, real estate, and academic businesses in India and internationally. It operates through Media Services, Realty, and IT Services segments. The company offers IT infrastructure management; network design and implementation; server and desktop virtualization; cloud services and migration; disaster recovery and business continuity planning; warranty and logistics management; cyber security and managed; managed print; software services, including cloud services, web and mobile application development, product engineering, and DevOps consultation and implementation services; software integration; and systems integration and enterprise IT solutions comprising IMAC services, migration, upgrades, network design and implementation, supply, and deployment of hardware, including data centers. It also provides visual effects and digital intermediate services; and cloud infrastructure, enterprise security, RPA, and training services, as well as rents out commercial built-up space. In addition, the company offers system/subsystem; turnkey solutions; and TETRA radio systems, software-defined radios, cognitive radios, Wi-MAX, mobile adhoc networks, wireless sensor networks, and networking products. Accel Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
